lines.text: تأرجح ذراع البندول (اليمين). ادعم نفسك على طاولة باليد الأخرى ودع ذراعك الأيمن يتدلى ويتأرجح برفق في دوائر صغيرة. 1 دقيقة، 3 مرات في اليوم.
lines.source_en: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm hang and swing gently in small circles. 1 minute, 3 times a day.
lines.back_translation: Pendulum arm swing (right). Support yourself on a table with the other hand and let your right arm dangle and swing gently in small circles. 1 minute, 3 times a day.

lines.text: دوران للخارج مع شريط (اليمين). حافظ على المرفق بجانب جسمك وحوّل الساعد للخارج ضد الشريط. 3 × 10، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Outward rotation with a band (right). Keep the elbow against your side and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 × 10, every day.
lines.back_translation: Rotation outwards with a band (right). Keep the elbow next to your body and turn the forearm outwards against the band. 3 multiplied by 10, every day.

lines.text: جري مع شريط (الجانبين). اسحب الشريط نحوك بكلتا اليدين، واضغط لوحي الكتف معًا. 2 × 15، كل يوم.
lines.source_en: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, squeezing the shoulder blades together. 2 × 15, every day.
lines.back_translation: Rowing with a band (both sides). Pull the band towards you with both hands, and press the shoulder blades together. 2 multiplied by 15, every day.

lines.text: تمدد لعضلة الفخذ الخلفية (لم يُذكر الجانب). اجلس ورجلك (لم يُذكر الجانب) مستقيمة أمامك وانحنِ للأمام من الوركين حتى تشعر بتمدد خلف الفخذ. لم تُذكر الجرعة، ولم يُذكر التكرار. من سجلاتك: انحنِ من الوركين واحافظ على استقامة الظهر.
lines.source_en: Seated hamstring stretch (side not stated). Sit with your (side not stated) leg straight in front of you and lean forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not stated, how often not stated. From your records: Bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
lines.back_translation: Stretch for the hamstring muscle (side not mentioned). Sit and your (side not mentioned) leg straight in front of you and bend forward from the hips until you feel a stretch behind the thigh. Dose not mentioned, how often not mentioned. From your records: bend from the hips and keep the back straight.
